description: This file declares the ClientController class and related classes for managing client control and shared memory in the Rialto media client component. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and internal data members, serving as an interface for client control operations.

classes.name: ClientControllerAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to the ClientController instance, implementing IClientControllerAccessor.

classes.name: ClientController
classes.description: Implements client control functionalities, manages shared memory, and notifies clients of application state changes.

methods.name: getClientController
methods.description: Returns a reference to the ClientController instance.

methods.name: ClientController
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ClientController with a control IPC factory.

methods.name: getSharedMemoryHandle
methods.description: Returns the shared memory handle used for media playback.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client and updates application state.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Notifies registered clients of a new application state.

methods.name: initSharedMemory
methods.description: Initializes shared memory for media playback.

methods.name: changeStateAndNotifyClients
methods.description: Updates application state and notifies clients.
